verdict.summary: The documentation-only change is internally consistent and appropriately caveated. It correctly distinguishes XPath fn:avg(()) (empty sequence) from SPARQL Avg({}) (integer zero), explicitly admits that the out-of-tree Noir rejection behavior is not verified here, and preserves the research-grade/not-externally-audited posture. The reachability claim is supported by the in-tree verifier's fail-closed handling of GraphPattern::Group and Extend-over-Group, while the differential README accurately limits its evidence to scalar functions. No vacuous test or security claim is introduced because the change claims no new implementation or verification coverage.
